plain: Things needed for life, such as food and clothing

webster.text: Things necessary for some purpose; as the necessaries of life.

example.quote: We may therefore presume, that the articles which will be the object of this species of taxes will be either the real necessaries of life; or if not these, such as from custom and habit are esteemed so.
example.cite: Brutus VI, New York Journal, Dec. 27, 1787
